name: Yoga school in Toronto, Ontario
reason: First candidate, Yoga Centre Toronto (Iyengar, yogacentretoronto.ca), is blocked: its robots.txt has ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web groups with Disallow: /, so nothing was fetched. Second candidate, Toronto Yoga Co. (torontoyogaco.ca, Danforth), is a mixed yoga, mat Pilates and reformer studio with no named lineage; its retreats are all past or sold out, class prices sit in a booking widget with no published figures, and only the 200-hour training (April-June 2027) would count, so it is too thin and leans to fitness. Third search (Downward Dog, Ashtanga) found no own website, only directory and listing pages. Three searches used; city skipped.
